title: Target-code coordinate
statement: For an exponential breadth-first-search state $S$, the coordinate at index $9$ of its 17-entry counter vector is its target code $V$; that is, this coordinate equals $S.V$.
replaced:
For every state $S$ of the exponential breadth-first search procedure, the target-code
coordinate of its 17-entry register vector is $S.V$.
